name: chatgpt-ads-oppref
description: ChatGPT Ads landing: oppref on the URL, referrer chatgpt.com. Classifies as paid, not as a ChatGPT referral.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (#82, parity with click-trail-handler#231): oppref is a paid marker for ChatGPT Ads (source chatgpt, medium cpc, channel paid_other). It is stored as ft_/lt_/top-level oppref but is NOT a click ID: never in click_id_history or the selected click ID. Semver: classification change, CLASSIFIER_VERSION 1.3.0; additive payload keys, SCHEMA_VERSION 1.3.0.
